purpose: Field registry for the Graph / Neighborhood Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the revised 20-method Graph / Neighborhood candidate freeze.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name from the original frozen input JSON plus the 2026-05-03 targeted Graph supplement.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines row identity and preserves the candidate freeze.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise family phrase from the Layer 1 input and verified method evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates niche clustering, factorization, ecological, motif, reconstruction, and deep representation routes.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than parameter lists.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes expression matrices, spatial graphs, cell phenotype maps, scRNA references, and pretrained-model inputs.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Graph / Neighborhood.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the neighborhood, niche, graph, motif, factor, or spatial-context role; do not foreground unrelated downstream claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps cross-task methods scoped to the analysis problem.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as niche labels, embeddings, factors, motif signatures, or reconstructed neighborhoods.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local selection by output type.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the branch-local decision tree.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use CPU, Optional GPU, Required GPU, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource gate without implying runtime support.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps triage later engineering audit risk.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger spatial scale, multi-sample size, or high-resolution cell maps.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless public evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures large-map and atlas-scale caution without creating execution claims.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when an official or clearly primary source is confirmed; otherwise leave blank.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides traceable code source for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes direct method evidence from review or synthesis evidence.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on what is direct evidence and what is Layer 2 synthesis.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to two concise sentences. Explicitly distinguish PubMed/DOI/code evidence from synthesized comparison, burden, and caveat fields.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps evidence strength visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the conditional decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: Neighborhood Signal Unit
fields.definition: Dominant spatial-neighborhood signal unit used by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use concise free text grounded in the method table row.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates cell/spot niches, covariance neighborhoods, factors, motifs, ecological patches, and reconstructed neighbor graphs.

fields.name: Multi-sample / Cohort Cue
fields.definition: Whether the method is oriented to single sample, multi-sample, cohort-label, atlas, or transfer settings.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise cue; use unclear when public evidence is insufficient.
fields.topic_relevance: Graph / Neighborhood choices often depend on whether niches must be compared across samples or conditions.

fields.name: Reference or Prior Dependence
fields.definition: External reference, annotation, prior-knowledge, or pretrained-model dependence.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value; use unclear when unresolved.
fields.topic_relevance: Highlights reference mismatch, annotation bias, and prior-model concerns.

fields.name: Output Granularity
fields.definition: Main granularity of the produced neighborhood representation.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents mixing labels, factors, motifs, metrics, and reconstruction outputs as if they were interchangeable.

fields.name: Interpretation Anchor
fields.definition: Primary biological or mathematical anchor used to interpret the output.
fields.fill_rule: Use concise free text; do not inflate to mechanistic certainty.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes the decision tree branch-local and scientifically cautious.

fields.name: Scientific-risk Caveat
fields.definition: Concise caveat about bias, benchmark limitations, interpretability, reference mismatch, prior bias, or validation risk.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text. Do not convert caveat into a severity score unless evidence supports it.
fields.topic_relevance: Carries Scientific Critical Thinking concerns directly into method selection.
